# VSCode Dark Modern

VSCode Dark Modern reproduces the VS Code Dark+ palette in Obsidian with low-saturation, non-neon colours tuned for long reading and writing sessions. Its recorded description lists six muted heading colours, callouts with coloured left borders, custom checkboxes, theming for the Calendar and Graph views, Canvas card colours and a monospace editor font.

![VSCode Dark Modern screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leozague/obsidian-vscode-dark-plus/HEAD/screenshot.png)
